upstream.scope: planner only; world cloud from actual gz_depth; clock/origin compatibility

execution_feedback.scope: RACER native planning core with authorized-execution FSM feedback only. No execution-grid, candidate projection, native envelope refit, retiming or C2 terminal patch. Common ROS2 checks may authorize an unchanged native prefix with a known-free C2 stop; no new controller.
execution_feedback.execution_horizon: Prefer full native curve; else exact prefixes at 0.25 s intervals, minimum 0.5 s, with known-free C2 stop. Feedback caps continuation to accepted prefix. Native swarm preview remains the original proposal; common leases reserve the actual prefix and brake.

runtime: native ROS2 Jazzy/rclcpp, DDS and rosidl; no roscore, ROS1 bridge or TCP gateway
scope: planner only; native algorithm plus authorized-execution feedback; no simulator/controller import
